neighbours.label: cold and storage contexts where 'freeze', 'frozen' or 'frost' is the likely next word (fires on the word before it)
fire: Gardeners in the north wait until after the final spring frost to sow beans.
Pipes in an unheated cabin can easily burst when the water inside freezes.
Pour the broth into ice cube trays and freeze it for later use.
The lake was frozen solid by the middle of December.
Keep this vaccine refrigerated between 2 and 8 degrees and never freeze it.
A hard frost overnight killed most of the tender basil plants.
Leftover cookie dough can be wrapped tightly and frozen for months.
Cover the strawberries with straw before the first autumn frost arrives.
quiet: Gardeners in the north wait until the soil is dry in spring to sow beans.
Pipes in an old cabin can easily leak when the fittings start to rust.
Pour the broth into a large jar and refrigerate it for later use.
The lake was calm and blue by the middle of July.
Keep this vaccine in its original box and away from direct light.
A heavy rain overnight flattened most of the tender basil plants.
Leftover cookie dough can be rolled into balls and baked right away.
Cover the strawberries with netting before the birds arrive in June.

notes: card: peaks on 'do not'(freeze), 'the last'(frost), '(free'zing); + pole suppresses freeze/frost; probe: 'last frost' 0.63, 'do not freeze' 0.50 but 'do not shake' also 0.48
